items.title: Toggle Mark on Current Pane
items.description: mark this pane or clear its mark

items.title: Swap With Marked Pane
items.description: exchange the current and marked pane positions

action.tmux: if-shell -F '#{pane_marked_set}' "if-shell -F '#{pane_marked}' 'display-message \"Current pane is already marked\"' 'swap-pane -s {marked} -t #{pane_id}'" 'display-message \"No marked pane\"' \; refresh-client -S

items.title: Join Marked Pane Here
items.description: move the marked pane into this window

action.tmux: if-shell -F '#{pane_marked_set}' "if-shell -F '#{pane_marked}' 'display-message \"Current pane is already marked\"' 'join-pane -s {marked} -t #{pane_id}'" 'display-message \"No marked pane\"' \; refresh-client -S

items.title: Clear Mark
items.description: clear the marked pane without moving it
